text: Generate commit messages strictly in the format: @scope/type: Description.
Type must be one of present in scripts/commit-msg.js.
Scope should be inferred from the changed files (e.g., @backend, @frontend, @shared, or @global for root changes or generate name using context
Example: @frontend/fix: Resolve layout issue in login page
Example: @global/docs: Update README with setup instructions
Example: @shared/refactor: Improve utility functions for better performance
Example: @todo/fix: Add note about pending tasks in project documentation
